about: Frozen 2026-11-10, BEFORE any new word-pass pattern for the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was written (owner: 'Put it on the Act shelf, so the answer can state its sections'). Written by Claude (not a lawyer), so the same author wrote the questions and will write the patterns: a development set. POSITIVE = a question the Act's own text should reach although it does not name the Act; NEGATIVE = a question with a vehicle, a driver or a road in it that is NOT about the Act; TRAP = declared in advance as likely to be got wrong. A fresh held-out set follows the patterns.
